thread:
Marcos (AE): Heads up — HealthTech POC asking for an aggressive pricing concession. They want Dedicated reserved capacity for 3 months + engineering support. Asking for 50% off list rate. Can we fast-track a review?
Elaine Pritchard: Hmm 50% is big. What's the expected ARR/ACV if they convert after POC?
Marcos (AE): POC to start in 3 weeks. Target ACV if successful is $250k/yr. They want the 50% for the first 3 months to validate throughput and latency.
Ryan - Sales Ops: Marcos, please paste the SKU(s) you plan to use and the ratecard version. Also need the margin delta spreadsheet.
Marcos (AE): SKU: RDW-DED-XL-8GPU, usage profile: ~200 concurrent tokens/min burst, estimated commit after POC: 1.5M tokens/month. Reference ratecard v3.2 (link: https://intranet.redwood/ratecard/v3.2).
DealDesk Bot: Ticket created: DD-7832 — "HealthTech POC concession request". Please attach the justification doc and customer SOW.
Elaine Pritchard: Can we consider an alternative structure: 3-month trial credits (60% credits) + a 1yr conversion at standard commit pricing? That keeps list price intact but helps the POC.
Sara Liao: Finance note: any effective discount >30% on Dedicated SKUs requires VP Finance approval. Need projected gross margin after discount.
Ryan - Sales Ops: Marcos, upload the P&L calc and confirm whether this customer will sign an annual commit at conversion. Also, we need security signoff timeline — they indicated an expedited SOC2 review.
Marcos (AE): They are OK with a 1yr commit post-POC but only if POC proves perf. I'll get legal to prep a short SOW + conversion clause.
DevEx - Jamie: If we approve the POC infra, I can provision a dedicated pool in staging with monitoring hooks. Need a PO or internal approval note.
Elaine Pritchard: What about limiting the concession to only the first 100k tokens/month or capping $X in credits? That reduces runway risk.
Marcos (AE): Customer pushback likely; they want blanket 50% for three months. But I can try the capped credits angle.
Sara Liao: Also include data residency and KMS requirements in the SOW. If they require on-prem, cost is different.
Ryan - Sales Ops: For Deal Desk: margin impact sheet attached to DD-7832. Quick read: base list price monthly = $45k, requested effective = $22.5k -> delta = $22.5k/mo. 3-month exposure = $67.5k.
DealDesk Bot: DD-7832 updated: attachments received (margin_calc.xlsx, customer_poc_brief.pdf).
Elaine Pritchard: Ok my take: approve provisional 40% credit (or equivalent capped credit up to $60k) contingent on: 1) signed POC SOW with conversion clause, 2) customer completes security questionnaire within 2 weeks, 3) Finance VP ack on margin hit. If they won't accept cap, escalate.
Ryan - Sales Ops: Noted. I'll route to VP Finance for signoff (cc @Sara Liao) and add legal for SOW template.
Sara Liao: Escalated to VP Finance (threading + email). She wants a short exec summary — I'll draft.
Marcos (AE): I'll push the capped-credit proposal to the customer this afternoon. If they push back hard, we'll revert to you all.
DealDesk Bot: Approval step created: "VP Finance review" assigned to vp-finance@redwood. Estimated SLA 48h.
Elaine Pritchard: If VP Finance approves, Sales Ops should produce an internal amendment that records the effective discount, timebox, and conversion terms. Ryan?
Ryan - Sales Ops: Will do. I'll prepare amendment template and a clean clause for roll-to-commit: `If customer converts within 90 days post-POC, credits applied count as prepayment toward first 3 months of committed usage.`
DevEx - Jamie: Once we have approval, send me the order id and I'll provision the staging Dedicated pool with a metric dashboard (latency/throughput/cost).
Marcos (AE): Thanks team. Will update after customer response. :eyes:
DealDesk Bot: DD-7832 status: "Awaiting VP Finance review". Reminder pings scheduled at 24h / 48h.
Elaine Pritchard: Great — leaning to approve with cap. Keep summary short for exec review (one paragraph + numbers).
Sara Liao: Draft exec summary uploaded to DD-7832. VP Finance has ACKed receipt and will respond within the SLA.
Marcos (AE): Update — customer accepted capped-credit proposal (cap $60k). They signed the SOW draft and started the security questionnaire. Please proceed with provisioning once final sign-off comes through.
Ryan - Sales Ops: Noted. Preparing amendment and internal record. Will attach final SOW and sign-off once VP Finance responds.
DealDesk Bot: DD-7832 status: "Customer accepted capped proposal — pending VP Finance final".
Elaine Pritchard: Thanks everyone. Close loop once provisioning complete and hand off to Solutions Engineering for onboarding. :white_check_mark:
